notes.title: Update 1.1 Has Been Released
notes.content: Home Run Derby mode has launched. Select it from the intro or in general settings to try it out. You have 4 minutes to hit as many home runs as possible, and the bat is juiced so it is much easier to crush the ball out of the park. Compare your score with friends (leaderboard coming soon) and have fun!

notes.title: Major Content Update: Batting Cages, Drills, and More!
notes.content:
Finally, more content! Inside The Park VR has been updated with features like drills, automatic teleportation, and more. The buildings now illuminate at night, and a brand new environment has been introduced as well. Step into the batting cages and improve your swing. In addition, stadium sounds actually sound like they are coming from the stadium. The new addition of drills includes three unique drills: Targets, Soft Toss, and AI Catch. Each drill will train your skills in unique ways so that you can improve all aspects of your game. Other minor adjustments/updates have been added as well to make Inside The Park VR the best baseball simulator on the market.

Changelog:

Increased bat size
Added marker and auto teleportation for fly balls and pop ups
Added emission to lights and buildings
Improved night performance
Added batting cages environment
Added 3 unique drills
Improved stadium sounds
Minor bug fixes/enhancements
